script_purpose: Reconstruct the first OSM/DeFlock map-report date of current Chicago ALPR/ANPR cameras.
geographic_scope: City of Chicago OSM administrative boundary, Illinois
main_variable_definition: Earliest timestamp in the complete OSM element history where the object is visible and has man_made=surveillance plus surveillance:type=ALPR or ANPR.
critical_limitation: This measures when the camera was first mapped/reported in OSM, not its physical installation or operational date.
